-- store/store.go --
package store

import "context"

type DB struct{ Addr string }

//fabrik:provider
func NewDB() *DB { return &DB{Addr: "primary"} }

//fabrik:provider name=replica
func NewReplicaDB() *DB { return &DB{Addr: "replica"} }

//fabrik:inject db name=replica
func Helper(db *DB) *DB { return db }

//fabrik:inject DB name=replica
type Unused struct {
	DB *DB
}

type Pinger struct{}

//fabrik:inject ctx name=replica
//fabrik:provider
func NewPinger(ctx context.Context) *Pinger { return &Pinger{} }
